properties.displayName: MAS - Manual attestation for Implement real time threat detection with EDR and Dedicated SOC team to monitor
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure the organization have incident monitoring controls in place. (Monitoring-IR-147).

metadata.Description:
Real-time Threat Detection
Incident Response Automation
Continuous Monitoring and Alerting

for more details - refer to Control statement
Real-time Threat Detection
- Machine learning algorithms analyze log data to identify anomalies
- Behavioral analytics tools detect unusual user or system activities
- Automated correlation rules flag potential security incidents
Incident Response Automation
- Automated playbooks initiate immediate response actions for common incident types
- Orchestration tools coordinate response efforts across different cloud environments
- Configures alerts to be sent through multiple channels, including email, SMS, and integration with incident management platforms like PagerDuty.
Continuous Monitoring and Alerting
- A dedicated Security Operations Center (SOC) oversees all cloud environments
- Custom dashboards provide real-time visibility into security posture
- Tiered alerting system ensures critical incidents receive immediate attention
metadata.controlTitle: Ensure the organization have incident monitoring controls in place.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
